note: Native artifact registry for this run. Every registered finding in Result.md resolves through the ids below to real files under output/.

files.description: Structural profiling of all four panels: shapes, dtypes, missingness, duplicate-column detection, row-identifier detection, missingness pattern groups.
Resolves design structure: panel 1 complete factorial, panels 3/4 series x condition block layout, exact response identities, rank-block meaning.
Core analysis: sum-to-zero contrast ANOVA decomposition of the unreplicated factorial, response identity fits, cross-panel transfer under two alignment conventions, panel-2 calibration.

Robustness suite: alternative functional forms for the identity, level leave-one-out, whole-condition holdout, factor-C gradient vs partition tests, transfer permutation nulls, panel-2 bootstrap and leave-one-out.

Interaction inference for the unreplicated factorial: Tukey 1-df non-additivity, Lenth-style contrast scan, cell-interaction sparsity. Also preserves the invalid permutation test and why it was discarded.
Cross-panel correspondence: magnitude-column relations, response exhaustiveness, 13-level profile correspondence, column-role resolution.
Transfer boundary: 13-level identity-mapping permutation test (50000 permutations), leave-one-level-out stability, magnitude vs shape decomposition, supplied rank-block comparison.
Cyclic-shift fairness check, consolidated results.json / results_summary.csv, and all three result figures.
Confound check on the transfer claims: partial Spearman correlations controlling the magnitude columns, multi-predictor regressions, within-panel condition relations.
Extended diagnostic figures: intervention contrast, Lenth scan, level correspondence, leave-one-level-out, rank block, calibration residual, support map.
Consolidated machine-readable results for all registered findings, including panel inventory, resolved identities, per-finding numbers, robustness and counterevidence.
Flat one-row-per-claim summary table of the registered findings with their robustness note.
Figure for findings 1-3: variance decomposition of both responses, the rugged 11-level profile with bootstrap CIs and its linear fit, and the exact identity scatter.
Figure for finding 4: the 13-level transfer success to panel 4 and failure on panel 3, the cell-level response-shape failure, and the magnitude transfer on log axes.
Figure for finding 5: the 41 paired readings with the identity line and the fitted compressed slope, plus the difference histogram.

Extended diagnostics: intervention contrast in panel 3 vs panel 4, Lenth contrast scan, level correspondence, leave-one-level-out stability, supplied rank-block agreement, panel-2 calibration residual.
Raw structural profile payload: file hashes, per-column statistics, duplicate column pairs, missingness groups, factorial completeness.
Per-column profile table for all four panels: counts, uniqueness, missingness, integrality, constancy.
Resolved structure payload: panel 1 factorial, panels 3/4 block layouts, exact identities with residuals, rank-block scans.
Core analysis payload: contrast ANOVA decomposition, identity fits, transfer under both alignments, condition ranking agreement, variance splits, panel-2 calibration.
Robustness payload: identity alternative forms, level leave-one-out, whole-condition holdout, factor-C structure tests, transfer permutation nulls, panel-2 bootstrap and leave-one-out.
Interaction inference payload: Tukey non-additivity, Lenth contrast scan, cell-interaction sparsity, and the preserved invalid permutation test.
Cross-panel payload: magnitude-column relations, response exhaustiveness, 13-level profile correspondence, column roles.
Transfer payload: 50000-permutation identity-mapping tests, leave-one-level-out folds, magnitude vs shape decomposition, supplied rank-block comparison.
Confound payload: partial Spearman correlations controlling magnitude columns, multi-predictor regressions, within-panel condition relations.
Independent multi-worker verification registry: per-claim verdict, independently computed numbers, and counterevidence from six adversarial verification workers.

Execution log of every analysis step actually run, including the ten real errors encountered and their resolutions, plus the post-analysis verification phase and the seven corrections the verification workers forced.

Correction of the errors-in-variables argument in Finding 5: reproduces the positive control that invalidated the withdrawn lambda-sweep bound, applies de-attenuation b_OLS/r^2, and runs calibrated null simulations for three noise models including the exact-design lattice block.

Payload for the corrected errors-in-variables analysis: positive controls for both the withdrawn and the replacement statistic, de-attenuated slope with bootstrap CI, and calibrated p-values for the equal-noise and lattice-block null models.
Independent replication of Finding 4 by verification worker V4: rebuilt cell table, 50000-permutation null, exhaustive cyclic shifts, and the joint two-magnitude confound control.
Independent structural audit of all four panels by worker V6; refuted the main agent's row-counter claim for numeric_feature_5, resolved numeric_feature_10, and found a second duplicate column pair.
